question:

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|}
\hline
\circ & \circ\circ & \circ\circ\circ \\
\hline
\square & \square\square & \square\square\square \\
\hline
\triangle & \triangle\triangle & ? \\
\hline
\end{array}
$$
hint: Count the number of shapes in each row. Row 1 goes 1, 2, 3. Row 2 goes 1, 2, 3. What should the last box of the triangle row look like?

question:
Three of these rooms hold the exact same value, but one room is the ODD ONE OUT. Find the room that has a different total than the rest:
$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|}
\hline
\text{Room A: } 4 + 4 & \text{Room B: } 12 - 4 \\
\hline
\text{Room C: } 2 \times 4 & \text{Room D: } 16 \div 4 \\
\hline
\end{array}
$$
hint: Solve the math problem inside each room! Room A equals 8. Room B equals 8. Room C equals 8. What does Room D equal?

question:
You found a secret pirate grid map! Gold coins, keys, and swords are hidden in different zones. If you go to zone C-2, what item will you find?
$$
\begin{array}{c|c|c|c|}
 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\
\hline
A & \text{Key} & \text{Sword} & \text{Coin} \\
\hline
B & \text{Coin} & \text{Key} & \text{Sword} \\
\hline
C & \text{Sword} & \text{Coin} & \text{Key} \\
\hline
\end{array}
$$
hint: Find the letter C on the left side of the grid, then slide your finger to the right until you are under the number 2 column!

question:
A spy secret code wheel matches standard letters to code letters by shifting them. Look at the top row and see how it matches the bottom row. Use the code wheel to decode the secret word: K H O
$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|}
\hline
\text{Real Letter:} & \text{H} & \text{I} & \text{J} & \text{K} & \text{L} \\
\hline
\text{Code Letter:} & \text{K} & \text{L} & \text{M} & \text{N} & \text{O} \\
\hline
\end{array}
$$
hint: The secret word is written in Code Letters. Find the code letter K on the bottom row, and look at the Real Letter right above it. Do the same for H and O!

question:

$$
\begin{array}{ccc}
\text{Box} + \text{Box} & \text{===================} & 10\text{ grams} + 4\text{ grams} \\
 & \triangle &

question:
A tiny robot starts at the bottom-left corner (A-1) of this grid map. If it moves 2 steps to the right, and then 2 steps up, what space does it land on?
$$
\begin{array}{c|c|c|c|}
3 & \text{Star} & \text{Moon} & \text{Sun} \\
\hline
2 & \text{Apple} & \text{Banana} & \text{Grape} \\
\hline
1 & \text{Robot} & \text{Car} & \text{Bike} \\
\hline
 & \text{A} & \text{B} & \text{C}
\end{array}
$$
hint: Start at the Robot (A-1). Move 2 steps right along the letters (A to B, then B to C). Now move 2 steps up along the numbers (1 to 2, then 2 to 3)!

question:
This bar chart shows how many magical gems Alex collected on Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday. Looking at the height of the bars, how many MORE gems did Alex collect on Wednesday than on Tuesday?
$$
\begin{array}{r|ccc}
6 & \color{purple}{\blacksquare} & & \\
5 & \color{purple}{\blacksquare} & & \color{purple}{\blacksquare} \\
4 & \color{purple}{\blacksquare} & & \color{purple}{\blacksquare} \\
3 & \color{purple}{\blacksquare} & \color{purple}{\blacksquare} & \color{purple}{\blacksquare} \\
2 & \color{purple}{\blacksquare} & \color{purple}{\blacksquare} & \color{purple}{\blacksquare} \\
1 & \color{purple}{\blacksquare} & \color{purple}{\blacksquare} & \color{purple}{\blacksquare} \\
\hline
 & \text{Mon} & \text{Tue} & \text{Wed}
\end{array}
$$
hint: Find the height of the Tuesday bar by looking at the number on the left. Then find the height of the Wednesday bar. Subtract Tuesday's number from Wednesday's number!

question:
You need to deliver a message from Town A to Town D. Look at the paths and the mileage points between the towns. Which path is the shortest total route?
$$
\begin{array}{ccccc}
 & & \text{Town B} & & \\
 & \nearrow 4 & & \searrow 5 & \\
\text{Town A} & & & & \text{Town D} \\
 & \searrow 3 & & \nearrow 7 & \\
 & & \text{Town C} & & 
\end{array}
$$
hint: Calculate the total cost for both routes! Path 1 goes through Town B: 4 + 5. Path 2 goes through Town C: 3 + 7. Compare the two totals to see which is smaller!

question:
In a class of 20 kids, a survey showed their favorite ice cream flavors. Look at the chart. If 12 kids like Chocolate and 13 kids like Vanilla, but some like BOTH, how many kids like ONLY Chocolate?
$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|}
\hline
\text{Total Kids} & 20 \\
\hline
\text{Like Both} & 5 \\
\hline
\end{array}
$$
hint: The chart says 5 kids like both. Since 12 kids like Chocolate in total (including the ones who like both), you just need to subtract the 'both' kids from the total chocolate lovers!

question:
Look closely at the numbers in this chart. They do not follow a normal math sequence. They count the number of straight lines used to draw each symbol! What number belongs in the last box?
$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}
\hline
\angle & \times & \triangle & + \\
\hline
2 & 2 & 3 & ? \\
\hline
\end{array}
$$
hint: An angle shape has 2 straight lines, an X-mark has 2 crossing lines, and a triangle has 3 lines. Count how many straight lines cross together to draw a plus sign (+).

question:
A builder stacks solid blocks on a table. The numbers in this grid show how many blocks are stacked on top of each other in that exact spot. If you look at this building directly from the FRONT, how many blocks are completely hidden from your view behind taller stacks?
$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|}
\hline
1 & 3 \\
\hline
4 & 2 \\
\hline
\end{array}
\\
\text{[ FRONT VIEW IS HERE ]}
$$
hint: Imagine standing at the bottom of the grid looking up. On the left side, a stack of 4 blocks completely blocks your view of the 1 block behind it. On the right side, a stack of 2 blocks sits in front—can you still see the stack of 3 blocks behind it?

question: Look at this perfectly balanced scale. We know that one single purple triangle weighs exactly 6 grams. If both yellow stars are completely identical, how many grams does a single yellow star weigh?
hint: Find the total weight on the right side first by adding the purple triangle (6g) and the weight block (4g) together ($6 + 4 = 10$). Since the scale is balanced, the left side must also equal 10 grams altogether. Split that total evenly between the two identical stars!
